_comment: S0-v2 B4 ruleset target — generated by the B4 card (feat/s0v2-B4-pipeline-fanout), NOT applied. The orchestrator executes this as a HARD SWITCH in ONE PUT (the B1-style union order — add new, observe greens, then drop retired — is not executable here: the six retired contexts no longer produce on this PR's head, so a two-step transition would leave required checks with no producing lane and the merge queue Pending forever). Live ruleset at PUT time had exactly 9 contexts: 6 retired lanes + Web / lint + Web / test + Web / build (verified via gh api repos/lifeodyssey/animichi/rulesets/19974534 on 2026-08-06). Required checks must never be in a state where every context is missing (bypass_actors: [] would leave Pending stuck forever). This PUT adds 23 new contexts (see required_checks below): the security lane names carry the caller prefix `Security / ` because reusable-security.yml is invoked by the ci.yml job named `Security` and GitHub's check-run name is the caller / callee concatenation (verified against live check-runs on main HEAD — see _notes).
required_checks: Security / Config check read-set trigger coverage

_deferred_required.reason: The lane is red on main HEAD: Pulumi preview (staging) fails with an R2 state backend 401 Unauthorized (credentials problem, orchestrator-owned, awaiting re-issued R2 keys; confirmed via main HEAD check-runs on 2026-08-06). A currently-failing lane made required would lock the merge queue immediately. Re-add after the credentials are fixed and the lane is green on consecutive runs.
re_add_conditions: pipeline-infra.yml 'Infra / build' green on consecutive main/PR runs after R2 keys are re-issued
the step-level dorny preview gate (BLOCK-2b) is in place — a path-skipped job produces no check-run, which is the second reason it must not be required until the gate and the lane are both stable
B7's REQUIRED_CONTEXTS table is updated in the same batch as the ruleset PUT

merge_group_trigger_required_first: Security / Config check read-set trigger coverage

_notes: Live ruleset check at generation time (gh api repos/lifeodyssey/animichi/rulesets/19974534, 2026-08-06): enforcement active, bypass_actors [], conditions ~DEFAULT_BRANCH, required_status_checks = exactly [Backend CI, Agent CI, Infra & DB CI, Cross-stack E2E, Repository Quality, Codecov Patch, Web / lint, Web / test, Web / build] (9 contexts). Web CI is already gone — B1 retired it.

This PUT deletes the 6 live retired contexts (list above) and adds the 23 new stage/security contexts; Web / lint + Web / test + Web / build were already required by B1's union step and stay. Quality / invariants is NOT currently required — it is one of the 23 being added.

Infra / build is deliberately NOT in required_checks for this PUT: main HEAD's Infra component CI is failing at Pulumi preview (staging) with an R2 state-backend 401 (credentials issue, orchestrator-owned, awaiting re-issued R2 keys). See _deferred_required for the re-add contract.

codecov/patch is NOT in the live ruleset: the 95% changed-line verdict is not currently enforced as a gate (the 'Codecov Patch' lane above is the retired upload/policy-precondition lane, not the codecov/patch status). The repo-side patch-coverage policy check lives in pipeline-quality.yml ('Verify patch coverage policy'); it does not make codecov/patch a required check. Re-adding codecov/patch as a real required status stays a backlog item (docs/ops/deployment.md), not part of this PUT.

Context names are GitHub check-run names, not job ids. The 9 security contexts are produced by reusable-security.yml jobs invoked from the ci.yml job named 'Security', so their check-run names are 'Security / <job name>' — verified verbatim against live check-runs on main HEAD (gh api repos/lifeodyssey/animichi/commits/main/check-runs, 2026-08-06): Security / gitleaks (secret scan), Security / TruffleHog (verified secrets), Security / osv-scanner (lockfile CVE), Security / Dependabot pnpm coverage, Security / Config check read-set trigger coverage, Security / zizmor (GHA security), Security / Semgrep (SAST), Security / sqlfluff (SQL lint), Security / post-deploy smoke scripts (shellcheck + behavior).

MERGE-GATE TRAP: all 9 security contexts run under ci.yml, which has NO merge_group trigger (only push/pull_request/workflow_dispatch). A required context that never produces on merge_group hangs the merge queue. Every name in _check_gates.merge_group_trigger_required_first must therefore be marked: 设 required 前必须先加 merge_group 触发器 — the orchestrator must add a merge_group trigger to ci.yml in the same PUT batch, or the security contexts must stay recommended until it lands. All other listed contexts (pipeline-*.yml lanes) already have merge_group.

Adding the security contexts is a Recommendation of this card (they were previously only indirectly required through the retired Repository Quality lane); Config check read-set trigger coverage is the one this card's own correctness depends on.
